description: This file contains implementation of DNS server iterator classes for handling DNS server selection logic, including DoH and classic DNS servers, with methods for attempting server selection based on failure counts and availability.

classes.name: DnsServerIterator
classes.description: Base class for DNS server iteration, managing common properties such as server counts, indices, and session context.

classes.name: DohDnsServerIterator
classes.description: Derived class implementing DNS over HTTPS (DoH) server selection logic, including handling server availability and failure counts.

classes.name: ClassicDnsServerIterator
classes.description: Derived class implementing traditional DNS server selection logic, managing server attempts and failures.

methods.name: GetNextAttemptIndex
methods.description: Selects the next DNS server index to attempt based on failure counts and availability, with separate implementations for DoH and classic DNS.

methods.name: AttemptAvailable
methods.description: Checks if there is any DNS server available for attempt based on current session and attempt limits, with separate implementations for DoH and classic DNS.
